full_judgment:
7. It appears that the Import Policy Order 2003-2006 has been made under the authority of section 3(1) of the Import and Export Control Act, 1950 (Act 39 of 1950) and in the said Import Policy Order, Article 1.3 provided that the government may review the order once in a year and may pass any order as it deems fit. The Provision of Article 1.3 of the Import Policy Order 2003-2006 runs as follows: 

 17. It appears that the Import Policy Order 2003-2006 has been promulgated under the authority of Import and Export Control Act 1950 and, as such, the same acquired the status of law and accordingly, the Provision of General Clauses Act is applicable upon it. Under the Provision of section 14(1) of the General Clauses Act the power to review and change the Import Policy Order 2003-2006 once in a year will be exercisable with prospective application since no contrary intention has been revealed from the article itself.
